notes.title: Untold Tales Publisher Sale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/63f0af401bbd518a9ceac4edfaaf3c217de03b74.png[/img]
[h2]Welcome, fellow gamers, to the sun-soaked shores of the Untold Tales Publisher Sale![/h2]
[h3]Prepare to embark on a gaming adventure like no other! Discover incredible discounts on a wide selection of our games for a limited time.[/h3]

[b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41232016/sale/untoldtales2024]UNTOLD TALES PUBLISHER SALE[/url][/h3][/b]
Explore diverse worlds, engage in captivating stories, and experience unforgettable gameplay like:[list]
[*] Become Ignis and restore the Eternal Flame in [b]Flame Keepe[/b]r with its newest update, which brought it out of Early Access.
[*] Jump into the Wild West with [b]Bang-On Balls: Chronicles[/b], bringing something for everyone, from the dusty saloons to the treacherous oil fields.
[*] Prepare for extra fun during your shift in [b]Read, Steady, Ship![/b] with the upcoming Let’s Party Update, which brings seven new minigames to the factory on June 28th[/list]

And rest assured, many more titles await you at unbeatable prices.

[previewyoutube=VuIPqL-GCeU;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/70a1b8f7ee7a896f973587c792a8cc9a352688a0.png[/img]
On top of that, we’re also launching a special gaming bundle - [b]Untold Tales Treasures[/b] - filled with 30 of our titles, each designed with one ultimate goal: to deliver a unique gaming experience that will leave a lasting impression.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42192/

This is your best chance to grow your gaming library and dive into the fun! 
[i]Quick, the Untold Tales Publisher Sale won’t stay here for long![/i]

notes.title: Small patch notes - v.002
notes.content:
After receiving a bunch of feedback from you, we were finally able to tackle the issues that were brought up. Thanks for letting us improve our game.

- Adjusted achievement values
- Added missing powerups
- Fixed the hero skin not unlocking
- Performance increases
- Other minor improvements
